source.citation: Dorrington, S.; Olsen, J. (2026), Parametric economic modelling of asteroid mining architectures, Acta Astronautica 241, 19-47

object_empirical_inputs.name: target_identity
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: join target facts, dynamics and later CIVPROP state

object_empirical_inputs.name: target_mass
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: whole-asteroid-return extraction mass; physical inventory ceiling

object_empirical_inputs.name: target_size
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: whole-body target selection and mass inference when combined with density/shape

object_empirical_inputs.name: bulk_density
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: mass inference from size/shape; whole-body physical inventory

object_empirical_inputs.name: taxonomy
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: paper's empirical proxy for resource-presence probability p_s

object_empirical_inputs.name: resource_presence_and_abundance
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: CIVPROP resource inventory and defensible p_s / extractable mass; paper illustrates >6 wt% H2O but does not provide a target-specific abundance model
object_empirical_inputs.sqlite_expectation: material evidence / abundance with scope and uncertainty

object_empirical_inputs.name: rotation_orientation
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: operations/site access, not the paper's core economic equations

object_empirical_inputs.name: surface_geotechnical_state
object_empirical_inputs.needed_for: credible mining-rate/recovery model, not parameterized by this paper

boundary: Solar Facts supplies empirical object state. Navigator supplies transport. Technology and economics belong downstream. Dorrington-Olsen is an economic/architecture kernel, not a complete resource-inventory model.
